capabilities.body: OpenAmer inoronga basa, yoriita nematurusi chaiwo — chiteshi chemirairo, bhurawuza, mafaira, kodhi — uye inochengeta zvakashanda.
capabilities.title: Mumiriri anofunga newe

capabilities.body: Hurukuro, ndangariro nemamodheru zvinogara pamuchina uyu. Hapana chinotumirwa kunze kunze kwekunge wakumbira.
capabilities.title: Muchina wako, mashoko ako

capabilities.body: Mitauro 186, mumwe nemumwe nemanyorerwo aunoverenga. Peji rekutanga reapp rinokubvunza waunoda.
capabilities.title: Mutauro wako, nemazvo

capabilities.body: Unyanzvi hunochengetwa kubva pabasa racho, saka mabasa ezuva nezuva anokurumidza paunoramba uchiishandisa.
capabilities.title: Kugona kunokura

help: Tarisa kuti muchina uyu unokwanisa kubatana neindaneti.
Kana zvikaramba kaviri, vhura zvinyorwa; mitsetse yekupedzisira inotaura nhanho yacho.
failure.lead: Hapana shanduko dzakadzoserwa kumashure chinyararire — OpenAmer inomira payamira, saka paunoimhanyisa kechipiri inoenderera ipapo.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer ichiri pashanduro yapfuura uye ichiri kushanda. Hapana chakatsiviwa nepakati.
failure.title: Kugadzirira hakuna kupera

language.lead: Kugadzirira kunoenderera mumutauro waunosarudza pano. Unogona kuuchinja gare gare muapp.
language.title: Sarudza mutauro wako

progress.lead: Kugadzirira kamwe chete: OpenAmer iri kudhaunirodha zvainoda nekugadzirisa muchina uyu. Paunozoivhura zvakare, zvose izvi zvinosvetukwa.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer iri kutsiva shanduro yapfuura. Zvirongwa zvako zvebasa, ndangariro nemasetingi hazvichinjwi.
progress.title: Kugadzirira OpenAmer

cards.body: Vhura app utsanangure zvaunoda kuti zviitwe. OpenAmer inoshanda nechekumashure yozokuudza zvabuda.
cards.title: Tanga nemutsara

cards.body: Masetingi → Chitarisiko → Mutauro. Mitauro nenzvimbo 186, zvinochinjika chero nguva.
cards.title: Sarudza mutauro wako

cards.body: Basa rinodzokororwa rinova unyanzvi — nguva inotevera rinongoda murairo mumwe chete.
cards.title: Rega irangarire

success.command: kana kuitanga gare gare kubva muchiteshi chemirairo:
success.lead: Zvose zvagadzirira. OpenAmer yava yako — pamuchina uyu, mumutauro wako.
success.title: OpenAmer yagadzirira

bullets: Inoshanda pamuchina wako — hurukuro dzako dzinogara pamuchina uyu
Zvose zvinogona kuchinjwa gare gare; hapana chisingachinjiki
welcome.lead: Mumiriri wako wega. Pamuchina wako. Mumutauro wako.
welcome.leadUpdate: Shanduro itsva yeOpenAmer yagadzirira. Inotsiva shanduro yapfuura ichichengeta zvirongwa zvose zvebasa nemasetingi.
welcome.note: Zvinotora maminitsi mashoma kana indaneti ichishanda zvakanaka.
welcome.title: Mauya kuOpenAmer
